news.title: Pilani Investment to sell 1.7 million UltraTech Cement shares for ₹1,908 crore
news.para: Pilani Investment plans to sell 1.7 million UltraTech Cement shares valued at ₹1,908 crore on August 13, 2026, at a 3% discount. Separately, UltraTech Cement is acquiring a 26% stake in Solaris Horizon Energy to support its green energy initiatives.

news.title: Two-storey dwelling units can now be redeveloped: Delhi development body
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority has sanctioned a policy focused on the overhaul of outdated two-storey residential units, with plans for broader application across the city. This will streamline building plan approvals by eliminating NOC requirements across multiple departments. Additionally, a crucial land use alteration for a metro depot in Narela Sub-City was approved, which aims to boost connectivity and promote regional growth.

news.title: PMAY falters in Mumbai as land prices, lack of bank credit leave 10,000-15,000 MHADA homes unallocated
news.para: The implementation of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana faces significant challenges in Mumbai due to high land costs and financing issues. Many eligible individuals are unable to obtain bank loans for homes valued between twelve and fifteen lakh rupees. Despite MHADA's construction of approximately fifty thousand residences, around ten to fifteen thousand units are yet to be allocated.

news.title: Ocean Seven’s licence cancelled in Gurugram, buyers seek another developer
news.para: Authorities in Gurugram have revoked the license of Ocean Seven Buildtech due to a stalled housing project, citing extensive delays and failure to meet construction milestones. Homebuyers expressed relief at the decision and are now searching for a new developer to finish the project. The government will assume control of the property, while investigations continue regarding potential fund misappropriation from buyers.

news.title: One in every three complaints lodged with Telangana RERA awaits resolution
news.para: Telangana RERA has a substantial backlog of unresolved complaints.  Nearly forty percent of lodged complaints remain pending resolution by the authority.  This contrasts with higher disposal rates seen in other major markets.  Telangana ranks high in project registrations but lags in complaint settlement.  Delays in project completion and refund demands are common complaint reasons.

news.title: Tamil Nadu RERA grants four-month extension to projects hit by West Asia disruption
news.para: Tamil Nadu RERA has extended the validity of registration and corresponding completion timelines of eligible registered real estate projects by four months. The relief applies to projects whose completion, revised completion or extended completion date falls on or after February 28, 2026.

news.title: Julius Baer leases 74,037 sq ft office space in Mumbai’s Andheri
news.para: Julius Baer India has secured a significant office space lease. The Swiss bank will occupy over 74,000 square feet in Andheri East. This new office space is for a duration of sixty months. The lease agreement commenced on May 1, 2026. This transaction highlights sustained demand for Grade A office spaces.

news.title: Grasim Industries'  profit up 39% to ₹3,846 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Grasim Industries reported a 38.8 percent profit rise for the June quarter. Revenue from operations increased by 21.43 percent, reaching Rs 48,716.20 crore. Strong performance across diversified businesses drove the highest-ever EBITDA of Rs 8,077 crore. Financial services and building materials segments showed substantial revenue growth. The company's budgeted capital expenditure for FY27 stands at Rs 3,157 crore.

news.title: Jaipur development body's tribunal order puts commercial use of residential land under spotlight
news.para: The Jaipur Development Authority Appellate Tribunal has mandated a thorough inspection of properties engaged in commercial activities. The tribunal highlighted that if any commercial operations are detected, the Jaipur Development Authority is permitted to take necessary legal actions. Furthermore, the appellant contended that land transitioned from agricultural to residential use back in 2005, but experts emphasize that such a conversion does not sanction commercial ventures.

news.title: DDA approves master plan Delhi 2047; focus on affordable housing, O-zone protection
news.para: Delhi's Master Plan 2047 has been approved, aiming for affordable housing supply.  The plan bans concrete structures in the Yamuna O-zone's core area.  Building plan approvals will be simplified by removing several NOC requirements.  Transit-Oriented Development will significantly increase dwelling units along transport corridors.  This new plan will guide Delhi's sustainable urban growth for the next two decades.

news.title: ANZ says home loan applications fall 12%, records A$1.9 billion quarterly profit
news.para: The ANZ Group, an Australian bank, witnessed a twelve percent plunge in home loan applications after the government eliminated property investment tax benefits. However, the bank reported impressive cash earnings of one point nine billion dollars for the third quarter. ANZ's shares bounced back early Thursday, outperforming the market, while costs saw a three percent decrease, which was well-received by analysts.

news.title: Indiqube Spaces’ net loss narrows 35% to ₹23.88 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Indiqube Spaces' consolidated total income increased 38.5 per cent to ₹448.81 crore during the quarter. Its area under management expanded to 10.61 million sq. ft., while steady-state occupancy stood at 90 per cent.

news.title: Shriram Properties’ net profit declines 46% to ₹11.04 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Shriram Properties' consolidated total income increased 3.6 per cent to ₹271.04 crore during the quarter. Sales rose 10 per cent year-on-year to ₹484 crore, while customer collections increased eight per cent to ₹365 crore.

news.title: Auto-mutation system clears 1,800 property cases in a week in Chandigarh
news.para: The new auto-mutation system in Chandigarh has revolutionized the way property mutations are processed, completing almost all cases seamlessly. With no need for applicants to visit the estate office in person, this digital approach streamlines transactions electronically post-registration. As a result, property records are updated quicker, minimizing delays while also promoting transparency and focusing on citizen engagement in property management.

news.title: Ghaziabad civic body slashes property tax for small shops
news.para: In a significant relief for small shop owners, the Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation has slashed property tax rates for establishments up to 120 sq ft to 1.5 times the residential rate. This beneficial change is set to aid over 30,000 traders in the city. Additionally, a one-time settlement scheme launching on August 15 will remove penalties and late fees, addressing a long-standing request from the trader community.

news.title: Land supply, urban planning reforms critical for affordable housing: NITI Aayog's Rajiv Gauba
news.para: Land supply and urban planning reforms are critical for affordable housing expansion. States and municipal authorities must unlock land and ease development norms. NITI Aayog proposes expanding planned urban areas and reserving land for affordable housing. Access to capital and strengthening rental housing ecosystems are also key. Government entities should unlock unutilised land for housing projects.

news.title: Bhubaneswar civic & development bodies raze 330 transit houses in joint drive
news.para: Authorities demolished 330 temporary shelters in Bhubaneswar on Tuesday.  Residents had overstayed in these transit houses, which were meant for temporary housing.  Many beneficiaries were allotted permanent homes but continued occupying the shelters.  The Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation and Development Authority conducted the eviction drive.  Further demolitions are planned for Wednesday to clear remaining transit homes.

news.title: Himachal Pradesh construction workers welfare board to disburse ₹20.61 crore to 4,967 eligible beneficiaries
news.para: On August 15, 2026, the Himachal Pradesh Board will allocate over Rs 20 crore to support around 5,000 construction workers. This strategic initiative aims to broaden welfare benefits for eligible workers statewide. Following meticulous e-KYC verification, about 70,000 ineligible beneficiaries have been eliminated. A major portion of funding is earmarked for marriage and education support, with the Hamirpur district receiving the highest financial aid.

news.title: Maha Metro proposes ₹14,520 crore metro network for Nashik city
news.para: A 58-km metro network is on the horizon for Nashik city thanks to Maha Metro's proposal. The first phase will feature two corridors of around 35 km, with timelines targeting 2031 and 2036 for operation. Following that, a 23-km corridor will connect Ambad to Nashik Airport in the second phase. Approval from stakeholders and the chief minister is still required to proceed.
